entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence under Sections 306,
420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It is alleged that daughter of the informant committed suicide due to ill-behaviour and torture by this petitioner and his family members.
4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that due to land dispute between the parties, petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
As a matter of fact, the victim herself created a Nikahnama from the court only to pressurize the petitioner and his family members.

5. However, learned A.P.P. for the State and learned Patna High Court CR. MISC.
